summary: Operator 2026-09-27 22:55 ET: "do rest of waves now". One package for the three remaining waves so building can proceed while each item's deploy waits on its scope. Wave 3 makes memory cognitive (checkpoints, lessons → procedural memory, contradiction adjudication, influence → ADVISORY). Wave 4 unifies (one worker contract, one agent registry, one model chooser, graph-native decisions/actions, ladder L4–L5, influence → WEIGHTED on advice). Wave 5 closes (ENFORCED where the divergence budget holds, conformance gate on promotion, self-healing L1/L2, independent 4.7 re-measurement, local embeddings for ladder step 7). MBI_BEHAVIOR stays 0 throughout: memory reaches cognition and advice, never the broker.

reviews.security: S-W4-1 sudoers allowlist (carried from W2 item 7); no new credentials

items.title: Cognitive checkpoints: CognitiveCheckpoint@v1 per agent (working + episodic layers) written at every wake / worker cycle end and restored at the next start — restart = thought continuity; new writer of data/cio/cognitive_checkpoints.jsonl (DSA row)
items.rule: §17 new writer of an authoritative store
items.rollback: TRADEAI_COGNITIVE_CHECKPOINT=0 — no writes, no restores; agents re-read files as today

items.title: Lessons → procedural memory: promotion queue (LessonPromotion@v1) fed by post-mortems / outcome lifecycle / self-repair; a promoted lesson becomes a ratified_lessons entry consumed by research prompts and the wake; promotion needs an operator APPROVE on this gate (batched weekly) — SHADOW until then (queue only)
items.rollback: empty the ratified set (one policy row); queue keeps accumulating

items.title: Contradiction adjudication lane (contradiction-adjudicator): paid judge over research_contradiction_candidates under the EXISTING Tier-2 $2/day cap and the off-peak rule; writes ContradictionVerdict@v1 and the contradiction_state on the GIR entity; new systemd timer (service grant)
items.rollback: disable the timer; verdicts are advisory rows only

items.title: Memory influence SHADOW → ADVISORY on two surfaces: research prompts (memory block rendered into build_research_prompt_context for Hermes lanes) and watchlist agent prompts — the model SEES memory; decisions still recorded, divergence measured (MemoryShadowMeasure@v1); per-surface policy rows
items.rollback: policy row back to SHADOW (one line) or TRADEAI_INTELLIGENCE_MODE=SHADOW

items.title: Adjudication judge spend inside the existing Tier-2 $2/day cap (deepseek-flash first, off-peak); no new paid lane; expected net spend DOWN because retrieval precedes generation

Worker contract on the remaining lanes: LeaseCoordinator + AgentHeartbeat + one status vocabulary (QUEUED/LEASED/RUNNING/DONE/FAILED/ABANDONED) across the five queue styles; each migrated lane keeps its store, gains lease + heartbeat
items.rollback: per-lane env switch back to the old claim path

items.title: One agent registry (config/agent_registry.json, AgentRegistry@v1) superseding the scattered agent lists; bus routing (AGENT_EVENT_ROUTING) and wake agent ids read it; the fan-out work items route by it
items.rollback: the old lists stay in place until the closeout PR marks them superseded

items.title: One model chooser: llm_consumption.gate_and_generate and the governed bridge both call the same choose_model(process, purpose, budget_state) — declared lanes → models in one config; no per-caller model strings
items.rollback: config maps every process to its current model (no behaviour change until an operator edits a row)

items.title: Graph-native decisions and actions: DEC:<guid> (cio_decisions, options thesis decisions) and ACT:<id> (action ledger) nodes with DECIDED_ON / CAUSED_BY / TRIGGERED edges in the GIR projector; the fan-out reaches open decisions

Supervisory ladder L4 (operator page through the ops-exempt Telegram path when L1–L3 fail) and L5 (orchestration-change proposal as an ApprovalPackage item) in the breach detector; L1 restart executes only under the S-W4-1 sudoers allowlist

items.title: Memory influence ADVISORY → WEIGHTED on the options CIO review and CIO advice surfaces: memory facts weight the ADVICE ranking/wording; never sizing, orders, stops or weights (MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0 unchanged); per-surface rows after the ADVISORY divergence measure is inside budget
sudoers allowlist for supervisor L1 actions (carried from W2 item 7, still NEEDS_LOCAL): systemctl --user restart of named lanes only; no system units; the detector never restarts anything without it
ENFORCED influence on the surfaces whose WEIGHTED divergence stayed inside the budget for 14 days (per-surface rows; each flip its own approval reply)

items.title: Conformance gate on promotion: cio_phase2_exact_main_deploy.sh refuses promote when the latest PlatformConformance@v1 report has a silo below its floor (operator override env for emergencies, logged)

Self-healing orchestration: L1 auto-restart (under S-W4-1) and L2 alternate-lane dispatch executed by the detector for lanes whose SLA row declares an alternate; every action a Breach@v1 → Recovery@v1 pair on the ledger

items.title: Independent maturity re-measurement lane (maturity-remeasure, weekly): scores the nine domains from receipts only (producer ≠ reviewer ≠ scorer), writes MaturityScore@v1 and the closeout table; the 4.7 claim is this lane's output, never a session's
